network.no_peers_yet: No swarm peers connected yet. Share your Peer Address so other SwarmLLM users can find you — more peers means bigger models can be run collectively.
hw.cpu_mode_tip:
Inference runs on CPU — responses are slower than GPU.

Models are memory-mapped from disk, so they use much less RAM than their file size. A 5 GB model might only use a few hundred MB of RAM because the OS only loads the parts being actively used.

GPU-enabled nodes handle requests faster and earn more credits.
hw.gpu_mode_tip: Inference running on GPU — fast inference, full credit earning
hw.cpu_only_tip: No GPU detected — responses will be slower. You can still host model data and earn credits from storage.
hw.vram_idle_tip:
GPU is not used for inference in CPU mode.

Models are memory-mapped from disk into RAM instead. This is slower than GPU but uses much less memory — the OS only loads the parts being actively used, so a 5 GB model may only use a few hundred MB.

This bar shows GPU driver memory only (baseline allocation).
hw.ram_tip_cpu: In CPU mode, models are memory-mapped from disk. Only the parts being actively used are loaded into RAM, so a 5 GB model may only use a few hundred MB. The OS manages this automatically.
hw.ram_tip_gpu: Models are loaded into GPU VRAM for fast inference. RAM usage is low.
hw.low_ram_tip: In CPU mode, models are memory-mapped from disk. Only the parts being actively used are loaded into RAM — actual memory usage is much lower than the file size.

pool.title: My Devices
pool.description: Link your personal computers, laptops, and servers together. Inference across your own devices is free — no credits used. Credits earned by any of your machines are combined into one balance on your main device.
pool.enter_code: Enter the code from your main device
pool.share_code: Enter this code on your other device:
pool.no_members: No devices linked yet. Generate a code to add your other machines.
pool.role_owner: Main device — all credits are combined here
pool.role_member: Linked device — credits forwarded to main
pool.code_invalid: Enter an 8-character code from your main device
pool.created_success: Device group created! Now generate a code to link your other machines.
pool.join_sent: Link request sent! This device will be added once your main device processes the request.
pool.confirm_leave: Unlink this device? Credits will no longer be forwarded to your main device.
pool.confirm_remove: Remove this device from the group?
pool.not_network: This is different from the SwarmLLM network — linking devices groups your own hardware, while the network connects you with other people.
pool.how_to_join: On your other device, open the dashboard → My Devices → Join, or run: swarmllm pool join CODE
pool.name_hint: Give this device a recognizable name so you can tell your machines apart.
pool.split_hint: Each device always keeps at least 50% of its own earnings. Since these are your devices, the rest goes to your main device's balance.
network.share_desc: Share with other SwarmLLM users so your nodes can discover each other on the network
network.connect_desc: Paste an address from another user to connect your nodes
network.not_devices: This connects you to the SwarmLLM network. To link your own devices, use the My Devices tab instead.
setup.connect_peer_desc: Paste a peer address from someone already running SwarmLLM. This connects you to the network — it's not the same as linking your own devices.
setup.auto_discover: No address? No problem — devices on the same local network find each other automatically.
pool.personal_only: ⚠ Only link your own devices. Linked devices forward 100% of their credits to the main device. Do not share invite codes with other users — this is for your personal machines only.
pool.forward_info: All credits earned by linked devices are automatically forwarded here. Inference across your own devices is free — credits are only used when your requests are served by other users’ nodes on the network. Your linked devices are always preferred for routing.
setup.link_device_desc: If you already have SwarmLLM running on another machine, enter the invite code to link this device. Credits earned here will be combined with your main device.
